messages:
Anya: Heads-up — while reviewing the Dedicated Capacity docs I found inconsistent examples for k8s provisioning + autoscale wording. Root PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482. Need quick sync on sample manifests and SLA phrasing.
Sam: Saw that. The k8s manifest in the onboarding guide uses `replicas` + HPA example mismatched to our scale policy. I can push a small YAML fix. :+1:
Devon: can you paste the problematic snippet? I have a suggested HPA block that matches the scalePolicy we document.
Anya: here — in onboarding.md under 'Provisioning example' there's:
```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
spec:
  replicas: 1
```
and then an HPA that targets cpu util but our runtime uses async-batching throughput, so wording is confusing.
Devon: proposed HPA block:
```
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    kind: Deployment
    name: redwood-runtime
  metrics:
  - type: External
    external:
      metric:
        name: redwood_request_rate
      target:
        type: AverageValue
        averageValue: "100"
```
Priya: Also SLA paragraph says 'best-effort isolation' — we should change to 'soft isolation (no eviction guarantees)'. That phrasing helped Legal in last review.
Sam: I'll update the k8s snippet and the HPA example to reference the SDK scalePolicy JSON and add a link to the dedicated scaling section.
DocsBot: PR created by Sam: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/487 — checklist: [x] unit examples [ ] link fixes [ ] cross-ref to SLA
Maria: I'll take the SLA wording and isolation section. Can we add an explicit callout about reserved-pool eviction behavior? One sentence and link to the SLA matrix.
Anya: Awesome. @Maria + @Sam — can you coordinate and aim to land both fixes before EOD Friday? If either needs Legal signoff ping me.
Sam: Yep, aiming EOD Fri. Will add a tiny SDK snippet showing scalePolicy -> HPA mapping.
Maria: I'll draft the isolation callout and add a short example of 'pinning' a deployment to a reserved pool.
Devon: FYI, here's a tiny scalePolicy example we'll link to:
```
{"scalePolicy": {"mode": "throughput", "target_concurrency": 12}}
```
Anya: Solid. Thanks everyone. I'll do a quick sweep after merges and close the PRs. :sparkles:
